name: pomegr
description: Configure and report bounded coding-agent signals to the local Pomegr observer.

interface.shortDescription: Repository policies and bounded signals for Pomegr
interface.longDescription: Adds repository policy workflows, lifecycle loading, delegation guidance, and provider-neutral reporting tools that Pomegr reads from Codex transcripts. The plugin does not send transcript contents or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this repository's Pomegr reporting policy.
Diagnose this repository's Pomegr reporting setup.
Report this task's current project-specific Pomegr signal.
